title: Docs: standardize SDK auth/retry/timeout/streaming guidance + migration notes
author: Elliot Price
description: Context: As part of the cross-SDK parity audit, we’re standardizing client behavior for auth, retries, timeouts, and streaming across Python/TypeScript/Go. This PR updates the docs site to (1) describe the new defaults consistently, (2) provide cross-language snippets that match the standards/ADRs, and (3) add migration notes for customers who will observe behavior changes (esp. retry + timeout + streaming disconnect handling). This is intentionally written to match the SDK implementations landing in: redwood-sdk-python (#412-#415), redwood-sdk-typescript (#287-#290), redwood-sdk-go (#198-#201). What’s included: - New/updated docs pages: Auth (API key sourcing, header, redaction guidance), Retries (classifier, backoff/jitter, budgets), Timeouts (connect/read/overall; streaming vs non-streaming), Streaming (SSE framing, cancellation, disconnect handling and what is/ isn’t retried) - Migration notes: renamed env vars, default retry behavior changes, clarified timeout semantics, streaming disconnect surfaced as retryable vs terminal depending on phase - Cross-language snippets for Python/TS/Go kept in sync (same parameter names as much as the SDKs allow; explicit notes where language differences exist) - Troubleshooting section referencing top support issues (SUP-9321/9334/9342/9355) and recommended mitigations. References: - ADR-0137 (SDK retry policy unification) - ADR-0138 (streaming disconnect handling) - API standard: client retry and idempotency guidelines (request-id, retry-after, idempotency expectations). Notes on wording: - Avoids implying server-side retries. - Avoids promising exact latency/SLO; focuses on client behavior and safe defaults. - Explicitly calls out that automatic retries only apply to idempotent requests or where the SDK can guarantee safety; streaming retries are not automatic beyond pre-first-token disconnect classification. Docs checklist: - [x] Snippets compile (ts) / import paths correct (py/go shown as conceptual, aligned to current packages) - [x] Security review: no secret material in examples; uses REDWOOD_API_KEY; shows redaction language - [x] SRE review: retry budget and jitter language matches recommended defaults - [x] Links: updated nav + sidebar, redirects for renamed pages. Follow-ups (not in this PR): - Add a small “SDK parity” banner to the quickstarts once quickstarts PR is merged (tracked in ENG-2491 subtask).
commits: docs(sdk): add SDK client behavior overview + nav entries
docs(auth): standardize API key sourcing + header + redaction guidance
docs(retries): document retry classifier, backoff/jitter, retry budget, and hooks
docs(timeouts): add connect/read/overall defaults; clarify streaming semantics
docs(streaming): document SSE parsing, cancellation, and disconnect handling policy
docs(migrations): add migration notes + troubleshooting tied to SUP tickets
chore: fix link checker failures + add redirects for renamed pages
release_notes:
- Docs: Updated SDK documentation for standardized auth, retries, timeouts, and streaming behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go.
- Added migration notes describing behavior changes and how to override defaults when needed.
- Added cross-language code snippets and troubleshooting guidance tied to common customer issues.
